name: Diploma in Engineering Technology (Mechatronics)
overview: Combines mechanical, electrical, electronic and control engineering to design and maintain automated machines and robotic systems used in modern manufacturing. Training follows the German dual-system approach with 70% hands-on workshop practice.
requirements: SPM/SVM: minimum 3 credits including Mathematics and 1 Science/Technical subject, and a pass in English
O-Level/IGCSE: minimum grade C in 3 subjects including Mathematics and 1 Science/Technical subject, and a pass in English
OR SKM Level 3 (related field) with at least 1 credit in SPM

name: German A-Level Preparatory Programme (GAPP)
duration: 20 months at GMI + 6 months intensive German in Germany
overview: A pre-university pathway that prepares students to study engineering at Universities of Applied Sciences in Germany. Students sit the German A-Level, TestDaF (German language) and complete a Vorpraktikum (pre-study practical training).
requirements: SPM: minimum grade C in English, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
O-Level/IGCSE: minimum grade C in English, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
Sponsored candidates: grade A in the core subjects (subject to sponsor selection)
careers: Bachelor of Engineering in Germany (Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, etc.)
Engineer in German or multinational companies

name: GMI-UTP Foundation Programme (GUFP)
department: Pre-University Programme (in collaboration with Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS)
overview: A one-year foundation in engineering and science based on the UTP foundation syllabus. Successful students progress to UTP undergraduate engineering degree programmes.
requirements: SPM: minimum grade C in Bahasa Melayu, English, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
O-Level/IGCSE: minimum grade C in 5 subjects including Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
careers: Degree in Engineering at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS
